privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information when you visit our website.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
content: We collect anonymized browsing data via Vercel Analytics to improve user experience.
No personally identifiable data is collected without your explicit consent.
Contact data is collected only if you contact us directly.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
content: Analytics data is used to optimize site performance.
Contact information is used exclusively to respond to your requests.
We do not sell or share your data with third parties.

cookies.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
content: This site uses technical cookies necessary for operation.
Vercel Analytics may use anonymized performance cookies.
You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
content: Your data is never sold to third parties.
Only our technical service providers (Vercel) can access anonymized data.
All transmission respects HTTPS security standards.

gdprRights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
content: Right of access: you can ask what data we hold about you.
Right of rectification: correction of inaccurate data.
Right to erasure: deletion of your personal data.
Right to portability: recovery of your data in structured format.
Contact us at josuerochadev@gmail.com to exercise these rights.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
content: All communications are encrypted via HTTPS/TLS.
Servers are secured by Vercel with enterprise standards.
No sensitive data is stored locally on your device.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
content: Anonymized analytics data is kept for a maximum of 24 months.
Contact emails are archived for 3 years then automatically deleted.
You can request immediate deletion at any time.

contact.title: Contact
